## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `confluent-cavroserdes-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Enable schema registry for your environment

1. <!-- manual: Log in to [Confluent Cloud](https://confluent.cloud/). -->
2. In the left navigation, select **Environments** and click your target environment.
3. <!-- manual: On the environment page, locate the Schema Registry panel on the right side. -->
4. Select **Enable Schema Registry** and select the cloud provider and region closest to your Kafka cluster.
5. Select **Enable**.

## Step 3: Retrieve the schema registry endpoint URL

1. <!-- manual: In Confluent Cloud, navigate to your environment. -->

## Step 4: Create schema registry API keys

1. In the **Schema Registry** panel on the environment page, select **View & manage schemas** or navigate to **Schema Registry** > **API Keys**.
2. Select **Add key** (or **+ Add API key**).
3. <!-- manual: Select the appropriate access level: -->
4. <!-- manual: Global access: grants read/write access to all subjects. -->
5. <!-- manual: Granular access: restricts to specific subjects or operations. -->
6. Select **Next**.
7. Select **Download and continue** to save your API key and secret. Store these securely: the secret is shown only once.
